title: Training Loops, Epochs & Batches — One Logical Batch Across Many Devices
key_insight: Data-parallel training averages gradients across devices, making the combined update resemble one larger batch. Communication happens before each shared optimizer step.
body:
## One Logical Batch Across Many Devices

A model trains on several accelerators. Each device sees different examples, so their gradients disagree before the update.

Data-parallel training averages gradients across devices, making the combined update resemble one larger batch. Communication happens before each shared optimizer step.

Gradient accumulation imitates a larger batch by summing several smaller ones before updating. Scale the loss consistently and count scheduler steps by optimizer updates, not raw mini-batches.
common_mistakes: An epoch is one single number inside a feature.
Validation should secretly train the model.
Larger batches always fit in memory and always improve accuracy.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “One Logical Batch Across Many Devices” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Correct loop structure keeps data, gradients, evaluation, and progress measurements in the right order.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “One Logical Batch Across Many Devices” situation, explain Training Loops, Epochs & Batches without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
